labels.shortDescription: AI-Readiness Export: section heading
AI-Readiness Export: what the section does
labels.value: Download your data model, and optionally your records, as files an AI tool of your choice can read. BarnCRM never sends anything to an AI service: you choose the tool and upload the files yourself.

labels.shortDescription: AI-Readiness Export: include records checkbox
AI-Readiness Export: include records help text
labels.value: Adds one CSV file of records for each kind of record through Find's export, up to the Find export row limit each, with the fields below left out or masked as you choose.

labels.shortDescription: AI-Readiness Export: include checks checkbox
AI-Readiness Export: include checks help text
labels.value: Adds each Data Quality check and its count, such as people without an email address.

labels.shortDescription: AI-Readiness Export: records need the Find permission
labels.value: Include Records and Include Data Quality Checks need the Find and Export Records permission.

labels.shortDescription: AI-Readiness Export: review button
AI-Readiness Export: hint before review
labels.value: Press Review Sensitive Fields to read the fields and choose what the pack does with sensitive ones. Download Pack is ready after that.

labels.shortDescription: AI-Readiness Export: sensitive fields heading
AI-Readiness Export: sensitive fields explanation
labels.value: These fields may identify a person or hold private details. Leave Out drops the field from the record files. Mask replaces each value with a code (the same value gets the same code in this pack). Keep exports it as it is.

labels.shortDescription: AI-Readiness Export: no sensitive fields found
labels.value: No field of the kinds of record you chose was flagged as sensitive. Check the fields yourself before you share records.

labels.shortDescription: AI-Readiness Export README: title
AI-Readiness Export README: intro, {0} is the date
labels.value: This pack describes your organization's Salesforce data so an AI tool can understand it. BarnCRM made it on {0} and sent it nowhere: you choose the AI tool and what to upload.

labels.shortDescription: AI-Readiness Export README: files heading
AI-Readiness Export README: schema.json line
labels.value: schema.json: every kind of record and field, with types, picklist values, help text, lookups, fill rates, privacy handling, relationships and data quality notes. Give it to the AI tool first.

labels.shortDescription: AI-Readiness Export README: data-dictionary.csv line
labels.value: data-dictionary.csv: the same fields as a spreadsheet, as BarnCRM's Data Dictionary downloads it.

labels.shortDescription: AI-Readiness Export README: data folder line
labels.value: data/: one CSV file of records for each kind of record. The first row holds field API names, explained in schema.json. Id and lookup columns hold record Ids, so files can be joined.

labels.shortDescription: AI-Readiness Export README: objects heading
README object line: {0} label, {1} API name, {2} field count
README object line: {0} label, {1} API name, {2} fields, {3} records, {4} file
AI-Readiness Export README: records stopped at the limit
labels.value: Not every record is included: this kind of record stopped at the Find export row limit.

labels.shortDescription: AI-Readiness Export README: relationships heading
README relationship: {0} is Object.Field, {1} is the related objects
labels.value: {0} holds the Id of a related record ({1}).

AI-Readiness Export README: no sensitive fields

labels.value: Left out of the record files: {0}.

labels.shortDescription: AI-Readiness Export README: masked, {0} is a list of fields
labels.value: Masked (each value replaced with a code that cannot be turned back into it): {0}.

labels.shortDescription: AI-Readiness Export README: kept, {0} is a list of fields
labels.value: Flagged as sensitive but kept as they are: {0}.

labels.shortDescription: AI-Readiness Export README: privacy advice
labels.value: Read your AI tool's terms before uploading records about people. Many tools keep what you upload, or train on it, unless you turn that off. Share only what the question needs.

labels.shortDescription: AI-Readiness Export README: data quality heading
README low fill: {0} is the percent, {1} is a list of fields
labels.value: Filled on fewer than {0}% of records: {1}.

labels.shortDescription: README check line: {0} is the check title, {1} is its count
AI-Readiness Export README: no data quality notes
labels.value: No data quality notes were included.

labels.shortDescription: AI-Readiness Export README: how to use heading
labels.value: How to Use It With an AI Tool

labels.shortDescription: AI-Readiness Export README: step 1
labels.value: Upload schema.json first, and ask the tool to read it before answering.

labels.shortDescription: AI-Readiness Export README: step 2
labels.value: Upload only the record files the question needs.

labels.shortDescription: AI-Readiness Export README: step 3
labels.value: Ask the tool to use the field API names in schema.json and to say which file each answer comes from.

labels.shortDescription: AI-Readiness Export README: step 4
labels.value: Check figures against BarnCRM before you act on them.
